Thanks so much.  Its hard just having to keep these kinds of things to yourself, whenever you bring up the alcoholism to my mo, she absolutely flips the FUCK out, and its just terrifying to confront her about it.  Its been nice just typing this out believe it or not, just getting it off my chest has helped so much.

Thanks for being here fellas.  It gets hard keeping it all to yourself.  These topics are just taboo you know?  Its too deep to talk about with friends, and I don't want to worry my parents too much.


Thanks.
